ideas.pitch: An automated pipeline that detects and mitigates socioeconomic bias in tabular predictive models used for automated loan approvals or hiring.
ideas.title: FairLens ML: Bias Detection and Mitigation Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous applied research and fairness evaluation, matching the technical depth expected by the Applied Research & AI/ML Club organizers.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered computer vision and satellite imagery pipeline that detects unauthorized land use changes and environmental violations around industrial zones.
ideas.title: GeoNex-Sat: Satellite Monitoring for Industrial Land Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real-world environmental monitoring challenge with concrete visual outputs, making the demo extremely compelling for judges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent diagnostic system powered by isolation forests and LLM reasoning to detect anomalies and trigger closed-loop remediation in industrial IoT telemetry.
ideas.title: IoT-Smart-Ops: Multi-Agent Edge Diagnostic Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines fast traditional machine learning for anomaly detection with modern agentic workflows, showcasing advanced system architecture.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning solution that predicts workforce churn risks from employee operational data and generates actionable retention strategies using SHAP explanations.
ideas.title: Human Capital Attrition Predictor and Retention Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a universal enterprise pain point with high economic impact and clear, interpretable model outputs that non-technical judges can easily grasp.

ideas.pitch: A predictive maintenance backend and digital twin platform that monitors electric vehicle battery degradation rates and forecasts failure windows.
ideas.title: VoltTwin: AI Battery Health Intelligence and Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on clean-tech infrastructure, providing real-time telemetry simulations and robust API design that appeals to engineering-focused evaluators.
